loci.title: Prior art for the equal-sum + equal-reciprocal-sum problem
loci.why: Highest-priority question in the brief. A false 'new' is a referee-facing embarrassment; a false 'known' needlessly weakens the paper.
loci.status: RESOLVED - no prior art; nearest relatives identified (Guy D16 / Schinzel; census-taker)

loci.title: Exact form and attribution of b_1, and availability of b_l for l>=2
loci.why: Load-bearing: Theorem C and Corollary D depend on eq. (4). Also decides whether the planned K<=n+1 extension is cheap or expensive.
loci.status: RESOLVED - eq.(4) exact; b_l explicit for all l via Ucar, cross-validated at l=2 against Schueth

loci.title: Does the Sec 1.3(b) priority claim survive?
loci.why: THE dialectical locus. Requires actively seeking the strongest case against the claim, not merely failing to find one for it.

loci.title: Novelty of the planned stability theorem
loci.why: Technique novelty and setting novelty pull in opposite directions and must be separated.
loci.status: NA half resolved (all standard, Batenkov-Yomdin is the template); orbifold-setting null pending
